Sección

Investigación

Cómo los datos históricos se convierten en evidencia falsable — datasets, backtests, walk-forward, OOS, replay, contrafactuales.

Metodología

Cómo los datos históricos se convierten en evidencia falsable — datasets, backtests, replay, contrafactuales.

Datasets EN

Canonical dataset contracts — fingerprints, quality gates, provenance, and the tick-dataset cache.

Backtesting EN

Deterministic, friction-aware backtests — what is simulated, what is honest about it.

Walk-Forward EN

Purged and embargoed walk-forward validation — why the purge exists and what happens when it was missing.

Puerta OOS EN

The hard OOS gate — floors, rejection semantics, and the evidence that it actually rejects.

Replay EN

Replay and streaming replay — bit-exact parity with the dataset, the anti-leakage guarantee, and how it differs from backtesting.

Contrafactuales EN

The NO_TRADE counterfactual engine — walking the decisions the engine didn't take, with stratified evidence.

Validación

La cadena de puertas — qué significa "validado" y por qué los rechazos se publican.

Reproducibilidad EN

How NSE makes research runs reproducible — fingerprints, frozen captures, deterministic seeds, provenance snapshots.
